perks.name: Emergency Electromagnet
perks.description: When your shields become broken, collect all nearby Orbs of Power and ammo bricks.
perks.exact:
Upon reaching Critical Health:
Picks up Ammo Bricks and Orbs of Power within 10? meters.
Picking up multiple Orbs of Power will count as simultaneous gains for the Repurposed Charges.

perks.name: Repurposed Charge
perks.description:
Whenever you gain, lose, or spend an Armor Charge, heal and gain damage reduction for a short time.

This effect scales with the amount of Armor Charge gained, lost, or spent.
perks.exact:
Gaining, losing, or consuming Armor Charges restores 5? HP and grants stacks of Repurposed Charge.

Repurposed Charge stacks are based on the amount of simultaneously(!) gained/lost/consumed Armor charges + 1.
Maxes out at x7 with 6 Armor Charges simultaneously lost/spent through Kickstart or Finisher Mods.

Initial Buff duration as well as Buff Extensions are equal to (3 seconds X Repurposed Charge Stacks gained/lost/consumed)
 Buff can be extended to a maximum of 30 seconds, maintaining the highest stack.
Examples: Orb Pickups grant x2 (13% DR) for +6 seconds.
 Special Finisher will grant x4 (29.5% DR) for +12 seconds. Picking up an Orb afterwards will maintain x4 stacks and add +6 seconds.

Repurposed Charge:
Grant Damage Resist per Repurposed Charge stack, up to 35% [?%] DR at 7 stacks.
x1 = 0% [0%] | x2 = 13% [?%] | x3 = 21% [?%] | x4 = 29.5% [?%] | x5 = 31% [?%] | x6 = 33% [?%] | x7 = 35% [?%]

item.name: Harmonic Scavenger
item.description: Arc weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.
item.exact:
On Ammo Brick Pickup to Mod-Element Matching Weapons:
Generally grants an additional +1 Ammo.

Machine Guns receive +7 Ammo.
Traces receive +10% Max Reserves.

By default, Ammo Bricks grant 25% to 33% of Reserves.
Works with Ammo Finder Bricks in full effect.

Does not function in PvP Game Modes.
